sources.quote: Generative AI tools were used during development to create or assist with portions of the game's pre-generated visual artwork, including horse illustrations, environmental backgrounds, contract and item icons, decorative UI artwork, the game logo, and Steam store and library artwork. AI-assisted tools were also used to draft or refine portions of in-game text and localization. All such materials were generated before release, then reviewed, selected, and edited by the developer, and are included in the game as fixed assets. No AI content is generated during gameplay, and the game does not connect to any external AI service.
